title: Nvidia's CEO Quit After 33 Years — What Happened?
description:
Nvidia's co-founder Jensen Huang resigned as CEO on Nov 12 after 33 years. The board later said he disclosed personal behavior inconsistent with the company's code of conduct, and that it does not intend to reinstate him. CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO. Who replaces him is still open.
